mainEntity.name: How long does it take to see results from an AEO Website Audit?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeframe for seeing results from an AEO Website Audit can vary, but typically businesses start observing changes within 2-4 weeks after implementing the recommended changes. Significant improvements in featured snippet acquisition and direct answer visibility often materialize within 2-3 months. Factors influencing this timeline include the aggressiveness of implementation, the competitiveness of your industry, and the frequency of search engine indexing. Consistent monitoring and further content optimization are key to sustaining and enhancing these initial gains over the long term.
acceptedAnswer.description: Businesses typically see initial results from an AEO Website Audit within 2-4 weeks post-implementation, with significant improvements in featured snippet acquisition appearing within 2-3 months. The timeline depends on implementation speed and industry competitiveness.
